method: Within each language: NFKC/casefold word trigrams; candidate pairs share at least 4 trigrams, have character-length ratio at least0.60, and difflib.SequenceMatcher similarity at least0.76. Exact normalized fingerprints are checked separately by the corpus validator.
limitations: Textual screening does not certify semantic uniqueness, global originality, native fluency, or comedic quality.
